record.edic_text:
1739 endomesis {en-dom'-ay-sis}

from a compound of 1722 and a derivative of the base of 1218;; n f

AV - building 1; 1

1) that which is build in
   1a) the material built into a wall, i.e. of which the wall
       is composed
   1b) a mole built into the sea to form a breakwater, and so
       construct a harbour
